f3e1b8bd: ;
 .;This routine computes the different averages and totals for each
 .;provider/specialty. It is expecting the ^TMP($J,"DGJTOT") global
 .;to contain the appropriate data. This routine displays the totals
 .;for each provider/specialty division in a columnar report.
f2231a63: ;Initialize totals for division and grand total.
23245010: ;Loop through each division, calling sub-routines to compute and display values.
2e886e92: ;Initialize counters used in computing averages.
e1bcd791: ;Print column headers for report.
9ecc3b49: ;Print summary line for division.
3e56d4c5: ;If there are more divisions, ask user to continue or quit.
027d92d2: ;End of subroutine.
1de5a707: ;Print report header with division name and date.
d010be92: ;Print column headings for averages.
f6f3d6ff: ;Underline column headings and print division name.
8bc283da: ;Add blank lines to advance past bottom of page.
41457691: ;Only prompt for continue if device is a terminal.
802242c2: ;Prompt user to continue or quit, branch if user quits.
0d45a1e6: Quit if no data is available.
4353be27: Set page number to 0 if new date/version/treating specialty.
a385204a: Print header with report type, date, and page number.
bfff25c9: If by service/specialty, print column headers for patient, patient ID, event date, and location.
e034218c: If by physician, print column headers for patient, patient ID, event date, and location.
abe06308: Print 'LOCATION' column header.
f3c9f4b4: If by service/specialty, print 'PHYSICIAN' column header.

d6aa532d: Print column headers for type, status (if direction is 2), dictation date, days from discharge to dictation, days from dictation to transcription, days from transcription to coding, total days, and delinquencies over 30 days.
120e8641: Print line separator and proceed to next line.
c984db28: Quit routine.
b12be72b: Quit if no data to print for current physician and patient.
8f1d0550: Print totals line with count, call CNTWR to print additional totals, call RET1 if not printing to console.
98464141: Display the count of patients for the current primary specialty, specialty, and procedure.
6c96f274: If there are more procedures to process for the current specialty, do not print the subtotal line.
770f6f7a: Display the service subtotal and average days-related statistics, respecting output device constraints.
8f8a6f69: Exit the routine.
db7aac47: Loop through physicians/services and display their statistics until encountering an empty entry or the user quits.
d646a6bb: Exit the routine.

983d6d0c: Display the physician/service name and their statistics for the total period: average days to discharge, average days to transfer, average days to coding, average days to delivery, and average days over 30 days.
e0c53538: Display the physician/service total encounters and relative percentage of total encounters.
9a12ebb2: Display additional physician/service statistics, handling potential user quit.
dd75d13f: Exit the routine.
d676e8fe: Set X to 0 if it is empty.
009c8039: If X contains a decimal, format it to display two decimal places and right-justify it in a 7-character field.
04892baa: Right-justify X in a 7-character field.
1ed05d5c: Display the average days-related statistics for the current device/physician.
782772c3: Display the remaining average days-related statistics for the current device/physician.
f37d9f7b: Exit the routine.
bfdf04d6: Accumulate the device/physician statistics into the corresponding totals.
d18b7f06: Exit the routine.
